population.selection: All 40 original development IDs in frozen membership order; no outcome-based filtering

decoding.policy: Same thinking-mode sampling through reasoning and final answer. Do not switch to non-thinking template at the boundary.

declaration.fraction_definition: floor(fraction * L), L = source reasoning token count excluding an emitted closing-think token, but retaining all sampled reasoning on capped traces. Exact cuts, no snapping. 0 independent, 100 forced/natural closing-think bridge and answer only. Intermediate fractions continue thinking, no answer-now instruction.
declaration.handoff: Native token-exact text replay of original thinking prompt plus prefix; no transferred cache, no added user turn, no future reasoning or source answer. Identical tokenizer hashes required.
declaration.retrospective_limitation: Fractions require full source length, unavailable to an online policy. Prefix work accounting uses measured cumulative source timestamps; full source collection is always charged to actual study work.

budgets.cap_failure: Preserve capped/early-EOS histories and answers. Never drop, extend selectively or replace a hard task. Oversized original prompt is an explicit protocol failure; do not crop.

declaration.reasoning_budget: At intermediate points receiver may generate at most 24576 minus supplied source reasoning tokens; original thinking context total bound is unchanged.
declaration.seed_scheme: SHA256 early_handoff_01|task_id|draw_index|stream first eight bytes modulo 2**63. One shared receiver_reasoning stream across fractions; three shared receiver_answer streams across fractions; source_reasoning and source_answer separate.

runtime.hardware: Apple M4 Max, 128 GB unified memory
runtime.model_loading: Separate source and receiver phases; one model resident at a time

analysis.interval: 95% paired task-cluster percentile; exploratory, no equivalence claims or confirmation
analysis.frontier: Observed quality vs latency and generated work. Local runtime cannot identify H200 $ frontier. All local monetary estimates exclude hardware depreciation and energy unless measured.
analysis.oracle: Retrospective task-wise frontier, explicitly nondeployable; no router

recovery.checkpoints: Tokens, RNG state, timings; recover cache by identical per-token replay after the same chunked initial prefill. Verify deterministic replay, never silently use a different prefill shape.
recovery.failure_policy: Preserve all planned tasks and explicit missingness; stop on integrity/resource failures

budget.local_hardware_energy_cost: not measured; not claimed free compute
budget.new_remote_allocations: disabled unless local infeasibility documented first
